en.title: VisionQuest Trailer Drops: Is Paul Bettany's Vision Finally Reunited With His Family?
en.summary: The first trailer for Marvel's VisionQuest has arrived, showing Paul Bettany's Vision embarking on a perilous journey to find his lost family. The series promises to delve deep into the synthezoid's existential crisis and his search for answers.
en.body:
The wait is finally over for fans eager to explore the lingering questions left by **WandaVision**. The brand new trailer for **VisionQuest** has dropped, and it plunges us headfirst into the existential turmoil of **Paul Bettany**'s **Vision**. Following his rebirth as White Vision and the transfer of his memories, the synthezoid is now on a desperate quest to reunite with the family he knew within the Westview anomaly. This journey isn't just about finding lost loved ones; it's a profound exploration of identity, purpose, and the very nature of his existence.

For those keeping score at home, **Vision** was tragically killed by Thanos in *Avengers: Infinity War*. **Wanda Maximoff** (Elizabeth Olsen), consumed by grief, used her chaos magic to create an entirely new reality in Westview, conjuring a perfect sitcom life with a Vision, and twin sons, Tommy and Billy. Meanwhile, outside the magical hex, S.W.O.R.D. resurrected the real **Vision**'s corpse, rebuilding him as White Vision with the intent to destroy the original. The **WandaVision** finale saw the two Visions confront each other, leading to **Vision** transferring his consciousness into his White Vision counterpart before disappearing. When Wanda eventually dismantled the hex, the conjured family vanished, leaving a void and a multitude of unanswered questions.

## A Son, A Villain, and an Identity Crisis

The **VisionQuest** trailer immediately throws us into the thick of it, with **Vision** wrestling with his fractured identity. A particularly chilling moment features **Ultron** (James Spader), whose digitized voice taunts, “That dead witch really did a number on you.” This line has sent fans into a frenzy, speculating if it confirms **Wanda**'s demise at the end of *Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness*. While the trailer offers little context for such a definitive statement, it underscores the dark and perilous path **Vision** is treading. His quest for family appears to be intertwined with confronting his past traumas and the malevolent forces that seek to exploit his existence. He's seen interacting with a young man named Thomas Shepherd (Ruaridh Mollica), who may very well be the reincarnated Billy Maximoff, adding a deeply personal layer to his mission.

## The Stakes Are Higher Than Ever

This series isn't just a continuation of **WandaVision**'s narrative threads; it's a crucial step in exploring the broader implications of **Wanda**'s actions and **Vision**'s place in the MCU. The fact that **Vision** is on the run, with a bounty on his head, and is consulting AI personas within his own programming highlights the profound isolation and danger he faces. The presence of **Ultron**, a villain intrinsically linked to **Vision**'s creation and **Wanda**'s trauma, suggests that this series will delve into complex moral questions and potentially redefine what it means to be a sentient being in the Marvel universe. Fans are buzzing about the possibility of seeing **Vision** truly come into his own, free from the manipulations of others and forging his own destiny, even if the trailer ominously suggests he's preparing for a fight he "likely won't win."

## What's Next

**VisionQuest** is set to premiere on Disney+ on October 14, 2026. Keep an eye out for further details regarding the full scope of **Ultron**'s involvement and the ultimate fate of **Vision**'s family.

content_raw: Marvel’s VisionQuest , the conclusion of the trilogy that began with 2021’s WandaVision and continued with 2024’s Agatha All Along , is almost here. For those a little behind on their MCU homework, Thanos killed Vision (Paul Bettany) in Avengers: Infinity War , and to cope with the grief, Wanda Maximoff/Scarlet Witch (Elizabeth Olsen) created an entirely new reality in a town called Westview using chaos magic. In this anomaly, she lived out her sitcom family dreams with Vision and twin sons named Tommy and Billy, whom she conjured with her magic. Outside the hex, the intelligence agency S.W.O.R.D. recovered the real Vision’s corpse and rebuilt him as White Vision, with the objective of destroying Vision and Wanda. The two visions faced off in the WandaVision finale, and Vision transferred his memories into White Vision before the latter flew off into the unknown. When Wanda dismantled the hex in that finale, those fake versions of Vision, Tommy, and Billy disappeared—or did they?  That mystery, along with the AI-turned-synthezoid’s existential crisis, is at the center of the latest trailer for VisionQuest . In the trailer, Vision wrestles with his identity and purpose, while the cruel and callous Ultron (James Spader) quips, “That dead witch really did a number on you.” Did Ultron confirm that Wanda died at the end of Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness ? It’s far too soon to tell based solely on a trailer that gives little context for such a bold statement. When Vision isn’t squabbling with Ultron, he’s trying to figure out whether a young man who goes by Thomas Shepherd (Ruaridh Mollica) is actually his son. With Vision preparing for a fight he “likely won’t win,” the stakes couldn’t be higher. The VisionQuest logline reads:  Vision, rebooted and having escaped from those who sought to weaponize him, has been in hiding. Searching for new meaning, he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., J.A.R.V.I.S., and the infamous Ultron. His discreet existence ends when a bounty placed on his head thrusts him on the run with Thomas Shepherd, a mysterious boy who may be Vision’s son, reincarnate. As Vision evades capture, he must confront his nature, resist Ultron’s influence, and unravel the enigma that is his young companion if he’s to survive. VisionQuest premieres with two episodes on October 14, followed by weekly episodes on Disney+. Watch the latest trailer below.
